# Brex — account brief

## Who

Brex offers corporate cards and spend management software for startups and enterprises ([source](https://brex.com/)). Its GitHub org is brexhq, linked to brex.com ([source](https://github.com/brexhq)).

## Production Expo signals

- `eas.json` is in brexhq/brex-mobile ([source](https://github.com/brexhq/brex-mobile/blob/main/eas.json)).
- package.json pins react-native 0.74.5 ([source](https://github.com/brexhq/brex-mobile/blob/main/package.json)).
- The repo has CI workflows in `.github/workflows` ([source](https://github.com/brexhq/brex-mobile/tree/main/.github/workflows)).
- The org has 27 public repos and 410 followers ([source](https://github.com/brexhq)).
- The org description names a regulated category, "financial" ([source](https://github.com/brexhq)).
- The App Store listing has 28,000 ratings ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/brex/id1472293141)).
- There have been 7 App Store releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/brex/id1472293141)).
- An open issue in the repo reads "expo upgrade to SDK 52 blocked by native module mismatch" ([source](https://github.com/brexhq/brex-mobile/issues/87)).

## Who to talk to

- Maintainer One (@brexhq-maintainer-1), top contributor to brexhq/brex-mobile with 260 commits ([source](https://github.com/brexhq-maintainer-1)). Their profile lists company "Brex" and website https://brex.com ([source](https://github.com/brexhq-maintainer-1)).
- Maintainer Two (@brexhq-maintainer-2), 133 commits to brexhq/brex-mobile ([source](https://github.com/brexhq-maintainer-2)). Their profile lists company "Brex" and website https://brex.com ([source](https://github.com/brexhq-maintainer-2)).
- @brexhq-maintainer-3, 58 commits to brexhq/brex-mobile ([source](https://github.com/brexhq-maintainer-3)). The record lists no company, location, or bio.

## Why now

brex-mobile last pushed 2026-08-15 ([source](https://github.com/brexhq/brex-mobile)), and the app shipped 7 App Store releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/brex/id1472293141)). The repo is on react-native 0.74.5 ([source](https://github.com/brexhq/brex-mobile/blob/main/package.json)) with an open issue titled "expo upgrade to SDK 52 blocked by native module mismatch" ([source](https://github.com/brexhq/brex-mobile/issues/87)).

## Suggested opener

You have 260 commits in brex-mobile, which is building with an eas.json in the repo ([source](https://github.com/brexhq-maintainer-1)) ([source](https://github.com/brexhq/brex-mobile/blob/main/eas.json)). There's an open issue there, "expo upgrade to SDK 52 blocked by native module mismatch", while the repo sits on react-native 0.74.5 ([source](https://github.com/brexhq/brex-mobile/issues/87)) ([source](https://github.com/brexhq/brex-mobile/blob/main/package.json)). Which native module is the one blocking the upgrade, and are you carrying it as a config plugin or a patched pod?
